payload.posture: Read Matthew 28:1–10 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states two women come at dawn; an angel descends, the guard trembles, the women see the place, run with fear and joy, and meet Jesus. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
